points.description: States that strings declared as character arrays have a null character ('\0') added at the end (a terminator), whereas the string type does not need/show this.
points.partial_credit: Award about 2 to 3 marks if the answer is on the right track but vague, e.g. says char arrays have an extra element or a fixed size/end marker without naming the null character.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying a character array string ends with a null element/character (\0), in any wording, even briefly. Part marks for vague related statements, such as an extra end marker or char arrays having a fixed size without mentioning null. No marks for answers that say nothing about the terminating null element.
